timeline.text: Driving through a valley, you'd hear a story about a farm you were never actually headed toward.
And every story just started mid-sentence, no warning before it began.
GPS now checks whether your road actually passes the place, not just nearby it.
You get a short heads-up first — 'in 200 metres, right' — before anything plays.
Only a one-line flash follows — full narration waits.
Full narration only starts once you've stayed close for eight seconds.
